name: COPRIME_NON_EQUALITY_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaces the easily-simplified inequality with a coprime condition on exponential functions (gcd(2^x+y, 2^y+x) == 1) that is mathematically equivalent to x != y for x,y in {1,2,3}. This hides the graph coloring structure, preventing the LLM from triggering its degree-ordered backtracking heuristic and forcing a naive search that will TLE.
